# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ascend C custom-operator project for HQSB S09 (E09-02/03/04).
#
# Layout and CMake entry points follow the official CANN operator project
# generated by `msopgen gen -f aclnn -c ai_core-Ascend310B1 -lan cpp`.  Only the
# operator sources are kept in the repository: the CANN build machinery itself
# comes from the installed toolkit via `find_package(ASC REQUIRED)`, so nothing
# vendor-specific is vendored here.
#
# Build: scripts/ascend/build_ascend_ops.sh  (never from the top-level CUDA
# CMakeLists.txt -- the CUDA and Ascend toolchains stay decoupled).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16.0)
project(opp)
find_package(ASC REQUIRED)
set(package_name ${vendor_name})

npu_op_package(${package_name}
    TYPE RUN
    CONFIG
        INSTALL_PATH ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/
)

if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/op_host)
    add_subdirectory(op_host)
endif()
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/op_kernel)
    add_subdirectory(op_kernel)
endif()
